d: Jet black hair is styled in an extremely long, high ponytail with short, choppy bangs framing the face. Large, expressive golden-amber eyes sit on a youthful face with the apparent maturity of a teenager, paired with a slender build. The outfit consists of a dark navy blue sleeveless top and matching short shorts, layered with a long, flowing blue and yellow cape, and finished with thigh-high laced navy boots. Signature details include a black thigh strap with a small pouch, a thin black bracelet, and a large, ornate mechanical staff with two floating blue spheres attached by black cables.
